title: Likh qalam sani e zehra ki sana bismillah
body:
Likh qalam sani e zehra ki sana bismillah
Ya zainab (6)
<<DIVIDER>>
Bismillah (4)
Likh qalam saniye zehra ki Sanaa bismillah (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Wahi o ilhaam ko tehreer milaa bismillah
Baa ke nuqte se har ek nuqta milaa bismillah
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj ye raaz zamaane ko bataa bismillah
Ilm e Hyder ka khulaasa hai Ali ki beti
<<DIVIDER>>
Doosri nehje balaagha hai Ali beti
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aal e zehra ke liye saniye zehra zainab
Isliye zaat e ilaahii ne ye chaaha zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Mustaqil ho Teri chaukhat pe ujaala zainab
Teri khaatir ho naye rang ka zohra zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Bani haashim ka qamar (2) banke sitaara jaaye
Teri dehleez pe GAAZI ko utaara jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
Jinki naalain ki kausain bhi mohtaaj mile
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo nabi aur Ali bar sare meraaj mile
Tohfe allah se do kal ke liye aaj mile
<<DIVIDER>>
Dono maasoomo ko ismat ke naye taaj mile
Shab e meraaj (2) ye taqseem khudaa ne kii hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatema ek ko dii, ek ko zainab dii hai
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maah e shaabaan e ekum aur wo noor e zainab
Kaaba e hazrat e zehra me zahoor e zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Panjatan hai isii khwaahish me huzoor e zainab
Meri aagosh ho gehwaara e toor e zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Uski marzii hai magar usko uthaaye Shabbir
Sabse pehle mujhe seene se lagaaye Shabbir
<<DIVIDER>>
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
Zulmate shaam ki tardeed hai pehlii shaban
<<DIVIDER>>
Teen shaban ki tamheed hai pehlii shaban
Chauda Maasoomo ki ummeed hai pehlii shaban
<<DIVIDER>>
Saari eido ke liye eid hai pehlii shaban
Arsh se banke (2) wilaayat ki safeer aayii hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Lailatul qadr ke ghar eid e ghadeer aayii hai
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ne us-qut(2) jo kahaa hogaye aadaa khaamoosh
Sirf aadaa hi nahii hogaya koofa khaamoosh
<<DIVIDER>>
Sirf koofa hi nahii hogayi dunya khaamoosh
Sirf dunya hi nahii arsh e khudaa tha khaamoosh
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisaa lehje ka asar tha, ke zamaana chup tha
Terii taazeem me khud Tera gharaana chup tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
Pal me saakit bhare baazaar ki halchal kardii
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Hi baat me har baat mukammal kardii
Waqt par waqt ki dehleez mukaffal kardii
<<DIVIDER>>
Din ko maazool kiyaa raat mu'attal kardii
Khauf me doobe huwe dil wo ubharne na diye
<<DIVIDER>>
Saans bhi rokdiye log bhi Marne na diye
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaafla farsh e azaa kaa ye chalii hai lekar
Chauda sadiyo se khitaab iska hai jaarii ghar ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Taaziya, jhoola, alam, aansu hai iska lashkar
Kaun rokeyga bhalaa shaah ka maatam akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala ka Jo har ek saahib e dil kaayil hai
Iski tableegh me Zainab ka lahoo shaamil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Salaam binte Ali salaam ya zainab (2)
Ya zainab (4)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
